sections.label: PPO and ComCare hotline figures
sections.summary: The Family Justice Courts received an average of 2,800 PPO applications yearly, with about 1,200 issued, and the ComCare hotline receives about 60 family violence calls annually.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In the past three years, on average, the Family Justice Courts received 2,800 applications for Personal Protection Orders (PPOs), with about 40% or about 1,200 PPOs issued each year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In the last one year, one in three callers who called the ComCare Hotline on family violence matters were non-family members, that is, third parties.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: On average, the ComCare hotline receives about 60 calls annually on family violence-related matters.

sections.label: Causes of family violence
sections.summary: Family violence commonly stems from controlling behaviours of one family member over others, and some families face stressors such as marital, financial or health challenges.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: One common cause of family violence stems from the controlling behaviours of one family member over other members, resulting in intimidation or violence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Some families also face difficulties in coping with stressors, such as marital, financial or health challenges.

sections.label: Vulnerable Adults Bill plans
sections.summary: The proposed Vulnerable Adults Bill will allow statutory intervention in high-risk maltreatment and abuse cases, with MSF finalising provisions before introducing it in Parliament this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The proposed Vulnerable Adults Bill will be an additional lever to allow statutory intervention in high-risk cases involving maltreatment and abuse of vulnerable adults.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Public consultation on the draft Bill was held in the second half of 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: MSF is finalising the provisions with relevant stakeholders and working through the details and standard operating procedures (SOPs) before introducing the Bill in Parliament this year.
